visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person's fair-skinned hand enters the lower right frame, placing a clean, reflective stainless steel bowl onto a white mat patterned with small blue bones and tan paws. The Chihuahua puppy sits quietly in the background, ears perked, against a backdrop of a white wire fence and a grey pet carrier. (2) The hand returns with a white bowl and pours brown, circular dry dog kibble into the metal dish. The kibble piles up in the center, and the puppy shifts its weight, intently focusing its large, dark eyes on the falling food particles. The lighting is bright and even. (3) A silver kettle with a long spout pours clear water into the bowl, partially submerging the kibble. The puppy remains seated and still, watching the water ripple. The setting is a clean, indoor environment with soft shadows and high-key illumination on the white surfaces. (4) A single index finger reaches into the metal bowl and stirs the wet kibble, creating a swirling motion. The puppy's head tilts slightly, observing the physical movement of the hand. The background remains consistent with the white wire mesh and the plastic pet enclosure visible. (5) The hand uses a small gold spoon to scoop beige, creamy pet food from a white pleated container. Multiple scoops are added on top of the wet kibble. The puppy continues to watch the food preparation with a neutral yet attentive facial expression and ears held alert. (6) A white plastic food press mold with a spring-loaded top is placed over the food. The hand presses down, then lifts the mold to reveal a perfectly formed, flower-shaped brown food structure. The puppy leans forward slightly, sniffing the air as the decorative food is revealed. (7) The camera shifts to a close-up of the puppy's face. It looks puzzled, blinking its eyes with its tongue slightly out. A digital graphic of a white rotating loading circle appears above its head against the white background. The puppy looks up and then back at the food. (8) The puppy moves its head toward the bowl and begins licking and biting the flower-shaped food. The camera zooms in further to capture the puppy's mouth and snout as it eats enthusiastically. The blue bone patterns on the white mat are visible in the shallow depth of field.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Playful, mid-tempo acoustic BGM with a bright piano melody and light guitar strumming begins. A sharp, high-frequency metallic clink sounds as the bowl is set down. The BGM remains at a consistent moderate volume, providing a cheerful and energetic atmospheric backdrop. (2) A textured, rhythmic rattling sound with short spectral bursts occurs as dry kibble hits the stainless steel bowl. The sound is dry and percussive, occurring over the continuous BGM. There are no vocal sounds, and the ambient noise is a very quiet studio floor. (3) A continuous, hollow pouring sound with mid-frequency resonance is heard as water enters the bowl. The liquid sound has a smooth texture and consistent volume. The background music maintains its tempo, and the overall acoustic environment remains crisp and well-defined without any distortion. (4) Soft, wet squelching and splashing sounds occur as the food is mixed. These sound events are quiet and have a low spectral bandwidth. The BGM piano chords sync loosely with the hand's movements, creating a sense of intentionality in the audio-visual production. (5) A distinct, mechanical 'click-clack' sound with a metallic resonance is heard as the mold is compressed and released. This transient sound event is sharp and occupies a high frequency range. The background music continues without interruption, maintaining its upbeat and friendly tone throughout. (6) A female voice exclaims 'Wow!' with a clear, resonant tone and a significant rising pitch contour. The vocal arousal is high, conveying surprise and excitement. The BGM ducks slightly to allow the vocal clarity to remain high, showing professional mixing and production style. (7) A bright, high-pitched digital 'ding' sound effect plays, followed by a comical, spring-like cartoon 'boing' sound. These SFX are loud and have high spectral brightness, designed to emphasize the puppy's reaction. The BGM tempo remains steady, and the acoustic floor is very clean. (8) Rhythmic, wet lapping and soft, crunchy munching sounds are audible as the puppy eats. These sounds are high-density and frequent, occurring close to the microphone. The BGM continues to play at a moderate volume until the end of the video, with no audio distortion.
